question: The surgical repair of cleft lip and palate is the only intervention required, and outcomes depend solely on the technical skill of the operating surgeon.

l10n.wrongAnswerMessage: Correct. Cleft care is inherently multidisciplinary. Speech therapy, orthodontics, hearing assessment (recurrent otitis media risk), and psychological support are all essential components of the long-term management plan.
l10n.correctAnswerMessage: This is false. Cleft management requires a coordinated multidisciplinary team including the plastic/maxillofacial surgeon, orthodontist, speech and language therapist, audiologist, paediatrician, and clinical psychologist. Outcomes depend on the entire care pathway, not just operative technique.
